from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json,subprocess
p=subprocess.run(['/bin/ps','-axo','pid=,ppid=,etime=,comm='],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
rows=[]
for line in p.stdout.splitlines():
 parts=line.split(None,3)
 if len(parts)!=4:continue
 name=Path(parts[3]).name.lower()
 if name in ('python','python3','python3.12','python3.14','limactl','colima','ssh'):
  rows.append({'pid':int(parts[0]),'ppid':int(parts[1]),'elapsed':parts[2],'executable':parts[3]})
print(json.dumps({'utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'returncode':p.returncode,'stderr':p.stderr,'counts':dict(Counter(Path(r['executable']).name for r in rows)),'processes':rows,'scope':'Selected executable names/PID/PPID/elapsed only; no process arguments or environment'}))
